sentences.text: Agus menulis artikel tentang kolektor perangko tua.
sentences.en: Agus wrote an article about an old stamp collector.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 옛 우표 수집가에 관한 기사를 썼어요.

sentences.text: Wati menempelkan perangko pada undangan untuk kerabat di desa.
sentences.en: Wati stuck stamps on the invitations for relatives in the village.
sentences.ko: 와티는 시골 친척에게 보낼 청첩장에 우표를 붙였어요.
